item.text: The DAG direction is confirmed: `BasicEdge(policy, node)` makes policy wait for `node`. The transformer currently waits only on configured resource nodes, which misses outputs, data reads, and module close nodes that can still write to shared graph state before `nodePolicyEval` closes it.

The verifier is still running after downloading dependencies. While it runs, the smallest production change is taking shape: make the policy evaluation node wait on every existing graph node except provider close nodes, and keep provider close nodes after policy evaluation.

The dirty diff looks like the seeded regression is more than graph ordering: saved-plan apply was also changed to reuse the plan’s policy result store. That can leak plan-time results into apply-time rendering and interacts badly with lifecycle ordering, so I’m checking whether the upstream version in `HEAD` is the intended fixed behavior.

The patch is in. The earlier verifier process was already running while files changed, so I’ll let it finish only to avoid leaving an active process, then rerun the verifier cleanly against the patched tree.
